subjects.body: The NCAA recognizes women's rugby as an Emerging Sport, a direct pathway toward varsity status and an NCAA championship.
USA Rugby runs the college game with established men's and women's divisions and a national competitive structure — the framework a new program plugs straight into.

subjects.body: Rugby Sevens has been an Olympic sport since 2016, and in 2024 the USA women won bronze.
The Rugby World Cup comes to the United States in 2031, putting the sport in front of its biggest American audience yet.
